title: Adobe Stock Wavers. Strong Earnings Aren’t Enough to Boost the Stock.
summary: Adobe  reported better-than-expected fiscal third-quarter financial results on Thursday night, but that wasn’t enough to reignite market sentiment.  Adobe posted fiscal third-quarter adjusted earnings of $6.13 per share on revenue of $6.76 billion.  Adobe also said it expects fiscal fourth-quarter revenue to be between $6.8 billion and $6.85 billion, compared with analyst estimates of $6.84 billion.

title: Adobe beats Q3 targets, but soft Q4 sales guidance triggers dip
summary: Investing.com -- Adobe Inc. (NASDAQ:ADBE) topped Wall Street’s third-quarter estimates on robust subscription growth, though shares edged down 2.5% after the software maker delivered a fourth-quarter revenue forecast that fell just short of expectations.
